title: An interpretable machine learning model for predicting NICU admission in preterm infants: a single-center retrospective cohort study.
summary: A machine-learning model using perinatal clinical indicators predicted NICU admission among preterm infants in a retrospective single-center cohort, with internal validation reported.
organization: The First Clinical Medical College; Gansu University of Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: The retrospective single-center cohort used internal validation. The article reports different AUC values in its conclusion text and later summary (0.861 and 0.904); the catalog claim therefore does not select one inconsistent value.
evidence.unknown: The retrospective single-center study does not establish prospective impact or performance at other hospitals.
evidence.ai_role: Uses prenatal indicators to predict NICU admission; SHAP summarizes model predictor contributions.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
